idea-plugin.name: SQL Synthetic Seeder
idea-plugin.description:
SQL Synthetic Seeder

Fill a table with plausible-but-validation-passing rows for manual or load testing. Enter the table name and its columns, pick a row count, and get INSERT statements where each row is one coherent synthetic persona and each column is mapped to a value by its name. Unlike a random faker, the IBANs pass ISO 7064 mod-97 and the cards pass Luhn. 100% offline.

  • Name-mapped columns: iban, card/pan, email, bic, vat/tax, name, dob/date, address, amount, id — anything else gets a stable placeholder.
  • Coherent rows: one persona per row, so the IBAN, BIC, name and tax id belong together.

Open it from View ▸ Tool Windows ▸ SQL Seeder, then Generate and Copy the INSERTs. Platform-only — installs in DataGrip and every IntelliJ-based IDE.

More Kassi tools for QA & fintech: Kassi Test Data, Checksum & Regex Playground.

Source, issues & docs: github.com/VadimToptunov/kassi-plugins
